lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba6Mg2 (reduced formula Ba3Mg) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both sites: Ba centers have 12 geometric neighbors (8 Ba, 4 Mg), while Mg centers have 12 Ba neighbors, with neighbor distances of 3.831–3.869 Å. The resulting geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and spans all eight sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Ba 12-vertex polyhedra, edge- and face-sharing between Ba and Mg polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among Mg polyhedra.
